shared: Eggs hidden in enemy units hatch into chicks when a fight clock strikes, and dormice sleep until then.
differ: Where power comes from: repeating chime combos, the enemy's own stats, or tuning the clock's speed.

takes.label: The chiming combo flood
takes.line: Every strike re-fires your Start of Combat effects and eggs can hatch three chicks each, so fights snowball into floods late.
takes.look_if: huge in-fight combo moments where every clock strike sets off more.

takes.label: Feed on their size
takes.line: Every chick takes a quarter of its host's stats, so tall boards feed you; hatches also Discover cards from the host's tribe.
takes.look_if: a tribe whose every egg grows with the enemy's size.

takes.label: Chicks behind enemy lines
takes.line: Chicks hatch and fight inside the enemy's line; eggs want a fast clock, sleepers a slow one, so you tune the speed.
takes.look_if: to tune one clock that your builds want at different speeds.
